name: io.github.taylee9809/budongsan-tax
description: Korean real-estate tax engine and MCP server. Statute trail on every result.

environmentVariables.name: LAW_OC
environmentVariables.description: law.go.kr Open API key. Optional; only the statute and ruling lookup tools need it.

environmentVariables.name: JUSO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: juso.go.kr address search API key. Optional; only the address-to-parcel lookup needs it.

environmentVariables.name: VWORLD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: vworld.kr Open API key. Optional; only the official price, zoning and redevelopment-zone lookups need it.

environmentVariables.name: VWORLD_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Service URL registered with the vworld.kr key. Optional.
